content_blocks.label: clause_1._Disposition_of_Estate
content_blocks.text: I direct that my entire estate, both real and personal, shall be equally divided among my children, Sarah and Mark.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Executor
content_blocks.text: I hereby appoint Michael Green as the Executor of this Will and grant him full authority to carry out the provisions of this Will.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Gifts
content_blocks.text: I give and bequeath to my beloved cat, Whiskers, a sum of $5,000 to be used for her care and maintenance.
